result.edit: In case 3'b000, change Y assignment from 1 to 0 so the output matches the oracle value 10 instead of 11.
result.replacement_rtl:
module JG3(ABC,X,Y);
	
	input [2:0] ABC;
	
	output X, Y;
	reg X, Y;
	
	always@(ABC)
    
        

case(ABC)
3'b000 : begin X = 1; Y = 0; end
3'b001 : begin X = 0; Y = 0; end
3'b010 : begin X = 0; Y = 0; end
3'b011 : begin X = 0; Y = 0; end
3'b100 : begin X = 0; Y = 0; end
3'b101 : begin X = 1; Y = 0; end
3'b110 : begin X = 1; Y = 0; end
3'b111 : begin X = 1; Y = 0; end
default :;
endcase
        

	
endmodule
